notes: New "What to expect" card when you prepare a job and on a waiting job: how long jobs like yours really waited on Draco lately (about half start before a given time; the slow case in the small print), read from the partition's recent history and kept on this computer. If you already use all the computers one person may use at once, it says so before you send. A waiting job is told that keeping its place costs nothing. Slurm's planned start, which assumes every job runs to its full time limit and is often days too late, has moved to Technical details, and the "When would it start?" button and the orange "no node can take this right now" banner are gone: they pushed people to ask for less RAM or time than their run needs. A COMSOL job's check on a compute node is now remembered for a week instead of an hour. Not code-signed yet.
